name: Loudoun County PRCS Teen Volunteer Program
org: Loudoun County Parks, Recreation and Community Services

offerings.summary: Loudoun teens from age 13 volunteer at community and recreation centres, athletic fields, pools, senior centres, parks and historic properties across the county.

age.raw: Students as young as 13 can volunteer with PRCS, but may be limited to specific volunteer opportunities.

sched.schedule_raw: Volunteer shifts are scheduled between Site Supervisor and volunteer

app.instructions: Contact, complete volunteer application, attend orientation workshop, visit your chosen host site; youthservices@loudoun.gov, (703) 777-0697

issues: Thirteen-year-olds may be limited to specific roles; the handbook does not say which
Only the Youth Services office address is published; host sites vary across the county
